description: PRD-55: Autonomous Assistant Platform - Transform Automatos from reactive multi-agent platform into always-on autonomous assistant. 5 workstreams: (1) Orchestrator Soul Designer in Settings, (2) Per-Agent Heartbeats with APScheduler, (3) Agent Skills Standard adoption + skills.sh integration, (4) Channel Adapters for Telegram/Slack/Discord, (5) Temporal Memory via Mem0 daily logs. Inspired by OpenClaw patterns but architecturally superior with team heartbeats and multi-agent orchestration.

userStories.title: Backend: HeartbeatService with APScheduler
userStories.description: As the system, I need a service that schedules and executes heartbeat ticks for the orchestrator and individual agents.
acceptanceCriteria: Create orchestrator/services/heartbeat_service.py with HeartbeatService class
Use APScheduler with Redis job store (via existing Redis infrastructure) for persistence across restarts
start() method: load all active heartbeat configs from workspace settings + agent configs, schedule jobs

agent_tick(agent_id, workspace_id) method: load agent + heartbeat prompt, check active hours, build context with agent tools + recent memories + current time, call LLM, execute tool calls if any, route notification per config
orchestrator_tick(workspace_id) method: check all agent health, review pending webhook failures (from unrouted_events), summarize today's activity, notify user if anything needs attention
Rate limiting: max 1 concurrent heartbeat per agent, max 5 concurrent per workspace
Job scheduling: cron trigger with interval from config, timezone-aware
Graceful error handling: heartbeat failures logged, don't crash the scheduler
Typecheck passes
